name: Yurkharovskoye Field - Yamburg-Urengoy Trunk Gas Pipeline

values.PipelineName: Yurkharovskoye Field - Yamburg-Urengoy Trunk Gas Pipeline

researcher_notes: No roster row matches (searched Yurkhar/Yamburg/Urengoy names; only long trunks e.g. P0774, P2358 Novoportovskoye-Yamburg). neftegaz.ru field page (loaded, verifier OK): 'С магистральным газопроводом Ямбург-Уренгой месторождение соединяется газопроводом протяженностью 51 км'; production since 2003, licence held by NOVATEK-Yurkharovneftegaz (100% Novatek). Length 51 km sourced (>25 km). Tier medium, not high: the ref describes the field connection and does not give the pipeline a name (name_found is the field name only), and gives no diameter or start year, so Diameter/StartDate left blank. TWO LINES / ONE ROW: vsluh.ru (loaded, 2006 pre-development article) says the 2nd stage adds a SECOND NITKA of 20 bcm/y from the field to the Urengoy-Yamburg jumper tie-in and on to KS Yamburgskaya, 'протяженность газопровода составляет 52 км'; neftegaz 261085 (2012) confirms 2nd-stage commissioning (4th start-up complex) but states no pipe length. It is unclear whether 51 km (existing line) and 52 km (planned 2nd line) are two separate pipes; the 52 km figure is a 2006 plan and is not used. Staged as one row for the verified 51 km line; a second row for the 2nd-stage nitka is NOT staged (no as-built length/date verified). Condensate line (326 km) is separate and parallel. PipelineType=gathering: field-to-trunk connection from a single producer's UKPG, not a transmission trunk (reasoned call; transmission is arguable given 51 km and trunk tie-in). Owner: entity_lookup finds no existing Yurkharovneftegaz entity in either tracker (new entity); Parent Novatek PJSC exists in oil tracker only (gas lookup empty) - reconcile name at staging. Route not found; OSM 102.3 km trace is unsupported and not a ref.
